notes: the first branch «أخبرنا ح» names no second link, so it ends at إبراهيم and the shared tail starts at أبي سلمة (written once after the last ح); «- المعنى وأنا لحديثه، أتقن -» is an editor's gloss, left out; «أبي سلمة، : سليمان بن سليم» is one man with a stray colon left out (rule 7); «ابن أخي» is the nephew named only by relation to Abu Ayyub
